Choose what to read and use

If literature, history, or philosophy is not your field, begin with selected Core views that speak to your questions. Consider their reasons and conditions, then try the useful parts in organizing experiences, revising personal material, or configuring your environment. Follow an essay when you want its fuller argument; reading the whole collection or adopting all its positions is unnecessary.

Writing your own philosophy, essays, or public website is a choice of interest. You can use the ideas and maintain your environment without taking on a writing project. If writing appeals to you, An example and a commons opens that route. Practical beginnings are in Using the Tools.

For a fully adopted Yinyang Skill, grounded relations are distilled into six personal working models for actual model collaboration: orientation, person, counterpart, relationship, environment, and revision. They state adopted philosophy and direction, understand the participants and their joint activity, and explain realization and continued revision. Their purpose is to make the actual personal environment fit the person psychologically and practically. Psychological and life evidence, together with maintained interpretations, principally belong in private references/personal/, with originals retained at their existing owners. Public work can express philosophy and selected understanding while the person retains their fuller personal understanding privately. These accounts state the positions and arrangements actually adopted; they do not require an original philosophical essay.

The personal-model condensation guide explains how these materials become descriptions of the person, the model counterpart needed, and their relationship. Joint work enters the world, and actual consequences revise understanding. Memory retains material and its origins; condensation organizes relevant meanings, conditions, and relations so available understanding can inform the next judgment and action.

Philosophy is a whole that can continue to be written. Literature, history, aesthetics, computing, and engineering can all supply material for understanding and condensation. Different views can be retained, compared, or combined without first joining one school. Accommodating conflict still distinguishes retained material, currently adopted understanding, and its consequences. Specialist methods and tools give the understanding usable forms; another person may develop an entirely different philosophy and environment.

The Documents & diagrams page presents the maintained documents and diagrams alongside their source links.

Philosophy, psychology, and engineering: develop the missing connection

Philosophy articulates understanding and direction, psychology understands the particular person, and engineering realizes the relationship in a usable environment. These contributions support one another. Enter through available material and practice and develop the missing contribution; the person need not first complete three academic disciplines independently.

If a usable engineering environment is missing, develop it with the model. Files, retrieval, tools, execution, and verification make formation and continued use possible; the person need not first master engineering. The maintained starting conditions distinguish actual philosophical writing, psychological or life material, and working environments, singly and in pairs. They identify the next contribution without making formation closed stages. Installed configurations can reflect constraints, habits, or defaults, so tool inventory alone cannot establish the person. Philosophy, grounded accounts, and environment continue to revise one another. Yinyang's package guide explains all six working files and their use, including the person's actual revision method.

Yinyang supplies culture, thought, and reasoning forms; personal substance comes from authorized actual material and the consuming model's collaboration with the person. Its essays and diagrams belong inside skills/yinyang/references/. They are accessories of that Skill. Other members retain their own purposes and specialist methods; collection membership does not make them Yinyang references or impose its philosophy on their use. In a combined practice, Yinyang is an example of a user's philosophy, while other Skills supplement it with concrete abilities. Readers can choose their own combination and write a different philosophy around it.

The public packages preserve the shape and useful companion relationships of the working local methods. Read each package’s dependency and configuration guidance, download the companions needed for the selected task, and bind your own tools and environment. A companion Skill supplies a method, not automatic authentication, device access, or a running service. Private participant accounts, credentials, personal records, and host-specific bindings are excluded.

Maintenance and contributions

Read Conversation and independent works for publishing your own work, asking through Issues, or requesting a song from boluopai. This repository does not accept pull requests.

MODEL.md owns collection maintenance and publication boundaries; AGENTS.md orients contributors. Each Skill owns any further interpretation and maintenance instructions in its directory. English is primary; reader editions retain full semantic parity where provided.

Use Issues for questions, corrections, suggestions, and song requests to the author. Keep personal accounts and private source material with their actual owner. Only authorized reusable material belongs in this collection.

License

Original Yinyang material uses CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, for noncommercial reuse; other reusable packages retain MIT. See the collection scope notice and each package’s LICENSE for applicability, attribution, separate rights, and earlier valid grants.
